Can Redwood initiate a cross-region steer to us-east-2 as a temporary mitigation and keep us posted on any potential billing/credit implications?

Tessa / Sanjay —

Quick plan (30-min action playbook):

- Step 1 (+5m): Confirmed failure mode is concentrated on AZ1. Runtime team to mark AZ1 instances as degraded and stop new session pins there.
- Step 2 (+10m): Activate geo-steer route: divert 60% of traffic to us-east-2 and 40% to us-west-1 (gradual shift to avoid amplifying cold-start).
- Step 3 (+20m): Warm caches in target regions using synthetic pre-warm calls (we'll run prefix warmers for the most common SKU prompts).
- Step 4 (+30m): Observe p95 and 5xx for 10m windows; if stable, shift remaining traffic.

Risks/notes: transient tokenization/latency differences may cause a slight increase in overall p50, but p95 and 5xx should drop if KV misses are the root cause. We will keep you updated every 10 minutes.

I'll attach the playbook and push the reroute. Rishi — please advise on any exec note you want me to send to Skyline's CTO/COO while we act.

Attachments: proposed-reroute-playbook.md
